decision.structure: CSharp platform factory and TargetContract feed one LLVM emitter. SLG target descriptors feed PrepareRequest/context before target-specific emission; semantic architecture enum meanings correspond despite different internal discriminant numbers.
decision.branches: Windows/Linux x64 runtime CPU dispatch with required SSE2 and optional feature mask1022; browser wasm32 baseline-only with zero optional features. Native compute/async/concurrent streams are enabled on Windows/Linux and gated off on browser targets.
decision.logic: Target triples and pointer widths match. SLG preparation transports architecture, dispatch policy and required/allowed/forbidden feature masks without deriving a replacement default. Wasm retains explicit hosted heap/source interfaces and unsupported filesystem stubs; their presence is not a browser filesystem capability claim.
decision.diagnostics: Current CSharp codegen capability guards and SLG target admission retain named unsupported native interop/COM/concurrency/browser boundaries. This comparison records descriptor selection and observed gates only; it does not certify every platform primitive or actual cross-platform execution.
decision.completionScope: Named target configuration source connection only; whole platform/runtime/performance and phase execution remain pending.
